name: Devastating Mockery
subtitle: rofl.n00b.sux0r
rules: COST – Pick a character. -- EFFECT – If the character is COVERT, it loses COVERT this turn. Then, draw a card.
flavor: Mirgla thought that at last the secret plans for the self-starting toastmajig millennium would be his, but the mocking he received from the elves of Bay 13 proved so mind-bendingly cruel that he wet his pants and ran away like a scared little girl.
notes: Catalog says 'EXTRA COST:'; card prints COST –, and adds 'Then,' before 'draw a card'.

name: Micromajig Factory
subtitle: it's a small world, after all
rules: WIND UP -- COST – Pay 4. -- EFFECT – Put a Micromajig token into play. -- (Treat Micromajig tokens as Gearsmith character cards with 1 strength, 1 life, and 3 speed. When they leave play, remove them from the game.)
notes: Catalog reminder text gives the token the 'majig' subtype and says 'When a Micromajig token leaves play, it disappears'; the card prints no majig subtype and says 'remove them from the game'.

name: I Got the Gear!
subtitle: a11.j00.n33d
rules: You may search your deck for a "gear" card. If you do, reveal it, and put it into your hand.
flavor: Elves can construct any tool you need. However, their unintelligible language makes special orders particularly difficult.
notes: Catalog: 'search ... for a gear card and reveal it. If you do, put it into your hand'; card: 'If you do, reveal it, and put it into your hand'.

name: Befuddling Beggar
subtitle: stench so thick you can chew it
rules: PANHANDLE -- COST – Deplete this card, pick a character. -- EFFECT – The character either gains or loses 1 speed.
notes: Catalog effect says 'This turn, the character either gains or loses 1 speed'; the card has no 'This turn' (no duration printed).

name: Legacy Warmachine
subtitle: still runs over people just fine
flavor: Those middle blades are for fighting giants. Granted there aren't any, but you never know.
